content:
Nora T.: heads up — customers in apac reporting 502s from private ingest. saw lots of mtls failures in logs.
Kemal S.: I see `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` for client certs coming from apac-edge. did a quick grep: many `KMS.Decrypt DENY` entries for keystore service-account in apac project.
Rhea (oncall): grabbing the keystore audit. paste in case someone already looked.
Nora T.: audit snippet: `protoPayload.status.message: "Permission denied: KMS.Decrypt condition_evaluation_failed"` and condition is `resource.labels.location == "us"`  someone templated the condition with hardcoded region earlier.
Kemal S.: oh that old binder template — it picked up `REGION` env from CI which defaults to us. Fail when we deploy to apac.
Rhea (oncall): mitigation: temporarily relax condition to allow the keystore SA to decrypt across regions while we rollover binder templates. I'll open a short-lived IAM binding with expiration + audit note.
infra-bot: noted. Create ticket INF-2026-443 and schedule 30m JIT allow.
Nora T.: also recommend adding a lint step in binder CI that fails if condition expression contains literal region strings. Owner: Kemal.
Kemal S.: will do. Also adding fallback in runtime: when KMS responds DENY due to condition, try alternate global principal. Small change in keystore — safe ada.
sec-bot: alert rule suggestion: fire `keystore.kms.condition_deny` if >3 events in 1m across any region.
Rhea (oncall): applied JIT allow, handshakes recovered within 2m. creating post-incident checklist: revert JIT after binder patch, add CI lint, add unit test for condition templating, update runbook. Closing for now, monitoring 20m.
Nora T.: thanks everyone. Remember to tag compliance for the JIT record. :thumbsup:
